title: Controlled rejection test for the CNF satisfiability proof
claim: This controlled verifier test leaves the enrolled CNF satisfiability-preservation goal unfinished for a renaming with a left inverse.
novelty: This submission exercises the live v2 proof gate using an intentionally incomplete expression. It claims no mathematical contribution.

prior_art.reference: Open Mathematics accepted CNF renaming lemma
prior_art.relationship: The credited renaming lemma is prior infrastructure for the enrolled satisfiability goal.

evidence.reproduce: Run the pinned isolated Lean verifier with the credited dependency. The candidate is expected to leave unsolved goals.

dependencies.use: A complete proof would use this lemma to rewrite evaluation after renaming. The test expression ends before that step.
dependencies.importance: This credited lemma links the renamed formula to evaluation under the composed assignment and supplies the exact dependency for this goal.

attribution.contributions: Prepared a bounded incomplete-proof fixture for the public verifier rejection test.

limitations: The expression intentionally omits the proof of the enrolled statement and establishes no mathematical result.
